notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Coveneth is now available as early access!

Since this is a new multiplayer title, I would suggest you find a few friends willing to try to game out before buying to ensure you'll have enough players at the precise time you wish to play. Alternatively, there is a discord server available, [url=https://discord.gg/2M3Q4HzFyH]#coveneth[/url], and steam matchmaking is integrated into the game. Thank you in advance to anyone willing to give this experimental game a try!

The released version contains a very limited set of quests to ensure there are fewer opportunities for bugs to occur. After this initial release is proven to be as stable as the internal tests suggests, I will work on implementing some of the features already in development, for example: items which can be used to identify a witch, and quests where villagers must hunt down a ghost while the witches try to provoke it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39415159/39472a9adc4e02b394de6dc2664f05f9edbb5e2b.png[/img]

Please feel free to use the bug report feature integrated into the game to send feedback! Thanks and happy hunting!
